# Local metadata envelope measurement, no app change or upload

Purpose: measure the complete allowlisted backup after the existing uploader
confirmed its 256-part bound. This is a separate streaming diagnostic, not a
larger upload or storage approval. The upload preparer retains 15s/256parts/63MiB.

Use source base `0038f3cdb655c33ea2fe364cb664d4ac4b1a9f09` of this repo in a fresh
isolated checkout outside cloud-synced directories. Never update or run the
installed app, its active checkout/backend, or the live library.

1. Fetch the exact source commit and this commit-pinned patch into a fresh private
   directory. Verify the patch SHA256 given in the handoff before applying. Read
   the patch, check it applies cleanly, then apply only in the isolated checkout.
2. Reuse the existing project Python3.13+ runtime/dependencies and Node22.23+.
   No dependency installation or app initialization. The original backend package
   is retained for signed peer/group exclusion; missing verification dependencies
   fail closed rather than permit foreign history.
3. Confirm the exact existing backup's SHA256 matches its private verification
   record. Do not send that raw database hash or its path to cloud.
4. With the same narrowly allowed backup-directory sidecar access as the successful
   check, run exactly once:

   `<existing-project-python> scripts/qualification/snapshot-envelope.py <exact-existing-verified-backup>`

5. Confirm the backup's hash remains unchanged. Return only script summary and
   unchanged-hash confirmation. Raw parts/rows/titles/events never enter chat/Git.

No immutable mode, checkpoint/vacuum/migrations, file deletion, new backup,
truncation, ordinary Sync, cloud login/activation/upload or retries.

The diagnostic retains all field/privacy/provenance/single-row/part checks and
one consistent WAL-aware read-only transaction. Parts stream through the exact
Worker validator in a separate local Node process and are discarded immediately,
not written as payload files or held as a whole library. The scan is bounded to
4096parts/640MiB, with a120s scan deadline and independent130s wall watchdog plus bounded teardown, about two minutes overall. This diagnostic bound does not authorize a collection
of that size. Exceeding it returns incomplete, not a partial-success summary.

The final summary includes canonical bytes/parts/table counts, largest row bytes
and traversal nodes, largest part bytes, omissions, Nov6/7 NewYork session start
counts/durations/open counts and a metadata-content digest. Naive session times
are UTC under the existing source contract. Compare the two sessions per day
previously verified; a mismatch blocks coverage acceptance. Open sessions have
unknown final duration and are reported separately.

The current upload format still excludes Sets/SetEntries/source bindings/raw
routine candidates, music/stems, settings/secrets and foreign peer/group history.
Do not describe the measurement as a lossless backup or a playable mix. Stop
once the summary is returned. We will choose and test transport only from the
complete measured envelope; partial progress must never be extrapolated to fit.

diff --git a/scripts/qualification/snapshot-envelope.py b/scripts/qualification/snapshot-envelope.py
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..d60964ce
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/qualification/snapshot-envelope.py
@@ -0,0 +1,68 @@
+"""Local-only full-envelope measurement. No upload, payload artifact or app import.
+
+Use existing project Python 3.13+, Node22.23+, against the verified BACKUP only.
+The existing upload preparer remains 15s/256parts/63MiB; this separate diagnostic
+allows a 120s streaming scan capped at4096parts/640MiB without retaining payloads.
+"""
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+import threading
+sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]))
+from backend.cloud_snapshot import measure_snapshot, PreparationError
+
+
+def measure(path, *, validator_command=None, wall_seconds=130):
+    started=time.monotonic()
+    process=subprocess.Popen(validator_command or ['node',str(Path(__file__).with_suffix('.mjs'))],
+        stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
+    # Bound a stalled validator/pipe too, not only SQLite/row processing.
+    expired=threading.Event()
+    def expire():
+        expired.set()
+        if process.poll() is None: process.kill()
+    watchdog=threading.Timer(wall_seconds,expire)
+    watchdog.daemon=True;watchdog.start()
+    def inspect(body):
+        if process.poll() is not None: raise PreparationError('local_validator_stopped')
+        process.stdin.write(body+'\n')
+        process.stdin.flush()
+    try:
+        result=measure_snapshot(path,inspect)
+        process.stdin.close();process.stdin=None
+        out,_=process.communicate(timeout=10)
+        verified=json.loads(out)
+        if process.returncode or verified.get('validator')!='pass':
+            raise PreparationError('local_shared_validator_failed')
+        if result['partCount']!=verified['partCount'] or {k:v for k,v in result['rowCounts'].items() if v}!=verified['rowCounts']:
+            raise PreparationError('local_envelope_count_mismatch')
+        verified['rowCounts']=result['rowCounts']
+        result.update(verified)
+        result['status']='complete_local_measurement'
+        result['elapsedSeconds']=round(time.monotonic()-started,3)
+        result['cloudUpload']=False
+        return result
+    except PreparationError as error:
+        return {'status':'blocked_incomplete_measurement','code':str(error),
+            'diagnostics':error.diagnostics,'elapsedSeconds':round(time.monotonic()-started,3),'cloudUpload':False}
+    except Exception:
+        return {'status':'blocked_incomplete_measurement','code':'local_measurement_wall_timeout' if expired.is_set() else 'local_measurement_failed','cloudUpload':False}
+    finally:
+        watchdog.cancel()
+        if process.poll() is None: process.kill()
+        if process.stdin is not None:
+            try: process.stdin.close()
+            except (BrokenPipeError, OSError): pass
+            process.stdin=None
+        try: process.communicate(timeout=3)
+        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+            process.kill();process.wait(timeout=3)
+
+if __name__=='__main__':
+    if len(sys.argv)!=2 or sys.version_info<(3,13):
+        raise SystemExit('Use existing project Python3.13+ and the exact verified backup path.')
+    result=measure(Path(sys.argv[1]))
+    print(json.dumps(result,separators=(',',':')))
+    raise SystemExit(0 if result['status']=='complete_local_measurement' else 2)

new file mode 100644
index 00000000..0f2c289d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/qualification/snapshot-envelope.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,40 @@
+// Local streaming validator. Generated/allowlisted metadata on stdin only. No network/files.
+import readline from 'node:readline';
+import crypto from 'node:crypto';
+import { validatePart } from '../../cloud/library/part.mjs';
+const input=readline.createInterface({input:process.stdin,crlfDelay:Infinity});
+let bytes=0,parts=0,largestPartBytes=0;
+const rowCounts={}, coverage={'2026-11-06':{sessions:0,durationSeconds:0,openSessions:0},'2026-11-07':{sessions:0,durationSeconds:0,openSessions:0}};
+const hash=crypto.createHash('sha256');
+const dayOf=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA',{timeZone:'America/New_York',year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit'});
+function instant(value){
+ if(value===null||value===undefined) return null;
+ if(typeof value!=='string'||!value) throw Error('invalid_time');
+ const stamp=new Date(/Z$|[+-]\d\d:\d\d$/.test(value)?value:value+'Z').getTime();
+ if(!Number.isFinite(stamp)) throw Error('invalid_time');return stamp;
+}
+try{
+ for await(const line of input){
+  if(Buffer.byteLength(line)>500000) throw Error('local_line_limit');
+  const value=JSON.parse(line);validatePart(value);
+  const body=JSON.stringify(value),size=Buffer.byteLength(body);
+  if(size<1||size>262144||++parts>4096||(bytes+=size)>640*1024*1024) throw Error('measurement_limit');
+  largestPartBytes=Math.max(largestPartBytes,size);
+  rowCounts[value.table]=(rowCounts[value.table]||0)+value.rows.length;
+  hash.update(String(size)+':');hash.update(body);
+  if(value.table==='sessions') for(const row of value.rows){
+   const start=instant(row.started_at),end=instant(row.ended_at);
+   if(start===null) continue;
+   const day=dayOf.format(new Date(start));
+   if(Object.hasOwn(coverage,day)){
+    const entry=coverage[day];entry.sessions++;
+    if(end===null) entry.openSessions++;
+    else{if(end<start) throw Error('invalid_duration');entry.durationSeconds+=(end-start)/1000;}
+   }
+  }
+ }
+ console.log(JSON.stringify({validator:'pass',canonicalBytes:bytes,partCount:parts,largestPartBytes,
+  rowCounts,includedSessionStartsNewYork:coverage,localContentDigest:hash.digest('hex')}));
+}catch{
+ console.log(JSON.stringify({validator:'failed',code:'shared_metadata_validation_failed'}));process.exitCode=2;
+}
